description: This file defines the interface for the IniFile class, which manages reading and writing key-value pairs to and from an INI configuration file. It includes method declarations for loading, clearing, retrieving, and setting configuration values, as well as a private filename and dictionary map. It also includes a friend test declaration for Google Test.

classes.name: IniFile
classes.description: A class that provides methods to load, clear, get, set, and flush configuration data stored in an INI file.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads configuration data from the specified file.

methods.name: value
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a given key, or returns a default if the key is not found.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the value for a given key.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Persists any changes to the configuration data, if applicable.
